Processing: By KPMP: integrated object including the Lake et al. (2023) atlas, with raw UMI counts, batch-corrected expression values and cell annotations. Log-normalized values averaged per participant (pseudobulk), keeping participants with >= 20 cells in the compartment. PT: cell type 'epithelial cell of proximal tubule'.
